record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Polyomino Tilings
record.original_question: A half-strip is a region obtained by intersecting a horizontal strip with a half-plane bounded by the y-axis. If a polyomino tiles some half-strip, must it also tile a rectangle?

evidence.quote: For instance, half-strip regions formed by the intersection of a horizontal strip and half-plane bounded by the y-axis.
Reid [32] asked whether tiling a half-strip implies that a rectangle can also be tiled
Open Problem 12 (Question 6 of [32]) Does every polyomino that tiles a half-strip also tile a rectangle?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A polyomino is a finite, edge-connected union of unit squares from the integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}^2$. A region $R \subseteq \mathbb{R}^2$ (a union of unit lattice squares) is said to be tiled by a polyomino $P$ if $R$ can be expressed as a union of pairwise interior-disjoint isometric copies of $P$ (allowing translations, rotations, and reflections). 

Define a half-strip to be a region of the form $[0,\infty) \times [0,h]$ for some positive integer $h$, viewed as a union of unit lattice squares (equivalently, the intersection of a horizontal strip of finite integer height with a half-plane bounded by a vertical line).

Question: Does every polyomino that tiles some half-strip also tile some rectangle $[0,a] \times [0,b]$ with positive integers $a, b$?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem, attributed to Michael Reid, appears to remain open. All known polyominoes that tile a half-strip have subsequently been shown to also tile a rectangle, but no general implication or counterexample has been established.

status_evidence.title: Tiling Rectangles And Half Strips With Congruent Polyominoes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies polyominoes tiling rectangles and half-strips; the implication remains an open question.
status_evidence.claim: The hierarchy implication from half-strip tiling to rectangle tiling is unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Polyomino tiling (UCF thesis)
status_evidence.snippet: All previous examples of polyominoes that tile half strips were either already known to tile a rectangle, or were later found to tile a rectangle.
status_evidence.claim: No counterexample is known; status remains open.
